sentences.text: If you were to examine the birth certificates of every soccer player in 2006's World Cup tournament, you would most likely find a noteworthy quirk: elite soccer players are more likely to have been born in the earlier months of the year than in the later months.
sentences.translation: 如果你查看2006年世界杯锦标赛中每位足球运动员的出生证明，你很可能会发现一个值得注意的怪现象：精英足球运动员更有可能出生在一年中较早的月份，而不是较晚的月份。如果你接着查看为世界杯和职业队伍输送人才的欧洲国家青年队，你会发现这一奇怪现象更加明显。

sentences.text: Ericsson grew up in Sweden, and studied nuclear engineering until he realized he would have more opportunity to conduct his own research if he switched to psychology.

This success, coupled with later research showing that memory itself is not genetically determined, led Ericsson to conclude that the act of memorizing is more of a cognitive exercise than an intuitive one.
sentences.translation: 这一成功，加上后来的研究表明记忆本身并非由基因决定，使Ericsson得出结论：记忆行为更多是一种认知练习而非直觉练习。换句话说，两个人在记忆能力上可能表现出的任何先天差异，都会被每个人如何"编码"信息所掩盖。而学习如何有意义地编码信息的最佳方法，Ericsson确定，是一个被称为刻意练习的过程。刻意练习不仅仅是简单地重复一项任务，而是涉及设定具体目标、获得即时反馈，以及同时关注技巧和结果。

sentences.text: In other words, whatever inborn differences two people may exhibit in their abilities to memorize, those differences are swamped by how well each person "encodes" the information.
And the best way to learn how to encode information meaningfully, Ericsson determined, was a process known as deliberate practice.
Deliberate practice entails more than simply repeating a task.
Rather, it involves setting specific goals, obtaining immediate feedback and concentrating as much on technique as on outcome.

During the past generation, the American middle-class family that once could count on hard work and fair play to keep itself financially secure has been transformed by economic risk and new realities.
sentences.translation: 在过去一代人的时间里,曾经可以依靠努力工作和公平竞争来维持经济安全的美国中产阶级家庭,已经被经济风险和新现实所改变。现在,一张解雇通知书、一次糟糕的诊断或一位消失的配偶,就能在几个月内使一个家庭从稳固的中产阶级沦为新贫困者。

sentences.text: Now a pink slip, a bad diagnosis, or a disappearing spouse can reduce a family from solidly middle class to newly poor in a few months.

From the middle-class family perspective, much of this, understandably, looks far less like an opportunity to exercise more financial responsibility, and a good deal more like a frightening acceleration of the wholesale shift of financial risk onto their already overburdened shoulders.
sentences.translation: 从中产阶级家庭的角度来看,可以理解的是,这其中的大部分看起来远不像是一个行使更多财务责任的机会,而更像是财务风险向他们已经负担过重的肩膀大规模转移的可怕加速。财务影响已经开始显现,政治影响可能也不远了。
